definition: AMP-CMD self-reported race/ethnicity. Race axis (African American / European American); 'Hispanic or Latin' reported here is an ethnicity with no separate race.

write.value_as_string: Hispanic or Latino (self-reported; race not separately specified)

note: AMP-CMD RACE from self_reported_ethnicity (a combined race/ethnicity field): African American -> Black 8516, European American -> White 8527, 'Hispanic or Latin' -> value_as_string (Hispanic is an ethnicity, not an OMB race). Lands observation 3046853 'Race'; CMD has no `race` column, so no overlap with race.json. Hispanic ethnicity STATUS is mapped separately from np_latino_yn -> Ethnicity.
